experiments.conclusion: Across 39 separately scaled dataset, LLM, and reconstruction-target cells, SAE JumpReLU (penalized) has the lowest mean NMSE in 18; raw-activation and delta_z targets are never compared on one axis.
experiments.title: Reconstruction error

experiments.conclusion: No method leads every available held-out identification cell: SSAE Linear (constrained sigmoid-L0) is the most frequent leader in 42/162 separately evaluated dataset, LLM, and metric cells. Direct best-family comparisons are gemma: SSAE 52, SAE 11, ties 3 across 66 best-family cells; most frequent within-SSAE leader SSAE Linear (constrained sigmoid-L0); matched nonlinear SSAE 93, SAE 96, ties 9, pythia: SSAE 49, SAE 16, ties 1 across 66 best-family cells; most frequent within-SSAE leader SSAE Linear (constrained sigmoid-L0); matched nonlinear SSAE 90, SAE 99, ties 9. LLM metric values are not pooled. Frozen nonlinear SSAE realized active-axis capacity is gemma mean 33.1%, range 8.7% (sycophancy, SSAE ReLU (penalized)) to 100.0% (bias-in-bios, SSAE JumpReLU (penalized)); pythia mean 83.1%, range 17.9% (sycophancy, SSAE TopK (penalized)) to 100.0% (bias-in-bios, SSAE JumpReLU (penalized)) across separately retained dataset and method cells.

experiments.conclusion: The complete matrix contains 90/90 dataset × LLM × method cells. Positive steering exceeds baseline in 78/90 cells, negative steering falls below baseline in 87/90, and the expected signed ordering holds in 78/90; Gemma and Pythia are reported separately.
experiments.title: Complete held-out signed endpoint steering

experiments.conclusion: On the clean, lexically disjoint corr-binary-occupation → eng-french transfer, direct family comparison gives gemma: SSAE leads (SSAE JumpReLU (penalized) versus SAE ReLU (penalized), SSAE−SAE +0.0071), pythia: SSAE leads (SSAE TopK (penalized) versus SAE JumpReLU (penalized), SSAE−SAE +0.0003). Across all source regimes the lead counts are gemma: best-family SSAE 3, SAE 0, ties 0, pythia: best-family SSAE 2, SAE 1, ties 0. Matched-activation counts are gemma: matched nonlinear SSAE 8, SAE 1, ties 0, pythia: matched nonlinear SSAE 4, SAE 5, ties 0; LLMs are not pooled. The legacy corr-binary regime remains a pair-mixture diagnostic because its household vocabulary overlaps the target.
experiments.title: Source-only OOD steering transfer

experiments.conclusion: JumpReLU responses recur across seeds (33.7% for SSAE and 24.2% for SAE), but both variants have zero concept-conditioned pairs with response correlation at least 0.5 and decoder cosine at least 0.8, and therefore zero stable 2-of-3 atom identities. Concept FDR alone remains architecture-sensitive; atom-level cards should require the separate cross-seed identity criterion.
experiments.title: Semi-synthetic feature selection and cross-seed stability

experiments.conclusion: Constrained SSAE has higher MCC-P on 3/3 dataset means and 14/15 paired dataset-seed comparisons than the affine baseline (mean paired delta 0.256); the worst dataset-level constrained relative MSE is 0.00416. This establishes recovery only for the frozen synthetic linear DGP.
